lines.x: All right, let's kick off the day with some energy!—is what I'd like to say, but same as always, let's play some games first.

Uh oh, I don't think I can look Midnight in the eye anymore. It used to be just funny watching him crash and burn hitting on girls, but now that I know he's actually dead serious about it... it's hilarious, I can't hold it in! What, you already knew? Tch, no fun.

The Spot we know isn't even close to his full potential. If he really tried, he might build something as big and impressive as Rhodes Island itself! So let's come up with a way to make him show what he's really got—hey, don't walk away, I'm serious!

There are two of me fighting inside my head right now! Hunter me wants to go on a hunt, but lazy me refuses to leave the couch—this is way harder than fighting a Zinogre! Ms. Orchid, come talk some sense into me... 'Do whatever you want'? Nooo!

Look, if you slot the sword into the shield like this, it turns into a giant axe! Cool, right? I hate being taken for a Kazimierz knight, but messing with the people who think that using this axe sounds pretty fun. I'm almost tempted to go back and enter a tournament again, heheh.

Huh? Dobermann's out again today? I already finished all my training assignments—I was gonna ask her for more. Try a class that isn't combat? Nope, nope. Same as ever, I'd be out cold in three minutes.

I'm bad with words, so I can't really explain it, but... fighting that Zinogre was the first time something inside me actually felt filled up. That's why I've been chasing that kind of thrill since we got back—Okay, okay, I'm sorry, Popukar. I shouldn't have made you mad over this.

The Blackflow Forest, the Foehn Hotlands, the Sami snowfields—I hear all those places have plenty of monsters worth taking on. But going alone is boring, so I've gotta figure out how to drag everyone along. Maybe I'll quietly rewrite Ms. Orchid's team-outing application form!

I'm back! I'm dead tired. Couch, my beloved couch, I'm gonna lie here for the rest of my life—These cuts? Don't worry about it, just scratches. Oh right, the haul's in the warehouse. It's a big one. Anyway, I'm out. Gonna sleep. Night!
Doctor, doesn't the sound of me sharpening my weapon feel super calming? Makes you sleepy, right? Want me to keep at it a while longer so you can get a good nap?
Doctor, I just swapped out my gear—can't we breeze through the formalities? Those combat mission applications? Don't worry about them, I just wanted to try something new, that's all.
Whoa! So that's another way to use that move! I'm gonna go try it at the training grounds!

I've been working pretty hard lately, so Dobermann's gotta have praised me, right? Let me see the comments! 'Improved combat technique and a shift in mindset have made her tendency to do as she pleases even more pronounced'... Huh?!
The purpose of fighting, the meaning behind picking up a weapon—is any of that really so important? Fine, I've decided! My goal is—to hunt down the mightiest beast on these lands!
Time's up? Nice, I'm all rested up! Let's go!
Leave the biggest one to me, you guys handle the rest. Sound good?
Hold on—I forgot my whetstone!
I hate war, but hunting? That's still a blast, heheh.
Gimme a sec, my meat's almost done.
Want some Bunny Dango?
You lot are my opponents? Not bad!
I'm wide awake right now, so you'd better watch out!
Little Wirebug, you're up!
Take my Morph Slash!
Phial, check. Charge, check. All right, here we go!
My shield's glowing. Know what that means?
What a haul! Just look at this big guy—let's hurry back and show everyone!
Ha! Did you see that perfect Super Amped Element Discharge just now?!
Tch, it got away. It's fine though—I've memorized its moves, so next time I'll definitely do better.
Masamune, get a cart ready for the Doctor, quick!
Mmm~ Home really is the best.
Doctor, I knew it was you.
Doctor, where's the next mission?
Arknights.

Year-end self-evaluations are such a pain. All I did this year was hunt or goof off, and if I write that down, Ms. Orchid will straight-up kill me. Oh, I know—I'll put: 'Made notable achievements in self-improvement and participation in group activities.' Perfect!
Doctor, wanna come hunting with me?

Doctor, do you smell meat? Think you're just hungry and imagining things? Nope, it's real. So put down your work and celebrate your birthday with a barbecue—Uh oh, Doctor, open a window, quick! It's burning, it's burning!

Without Rhodes Island, I probably wouldn't be living this freely. Not that any of you need me to say thanks—Tch, leaving a recording like this isn't really my style either. Anyway, Doctor, I sent along some trophies from this hunt with the recording. I'll be back soon!
